UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user profile in the ReuniteMe platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was last updated.

Item.title: Item
Item.description: Represents a lost or found item reported on the platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Item entity.

location.description: Location where the item was lost or found.

date.description: Date when the item was lost or found.

contactInfo.description: Contact information for the person reporting the item.

status.description: Status of the item (e.g., lost, found, claimed).

category.description: Category of the item (e.g., electronics, personal items, documents).

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the item was reported.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the item was last updated.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Represents a chat message exchanged between users.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ChatMessage entity.

senderId.description: Reference to UserProfile. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N ChatMessage - Sender)

receiverId.description: Reference to UserProfile. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N ChatMessage - Receiver)

itemId.description: Reference to Item. (Relationship: Item 1:N ChatMessage - Regarding Item)

message.description: Text content of the chat message.

timestamp.description: Timestamp indicating when the message was sent.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore data structure is designed to support the ReuniteMe platform's core features, emphasizing security, scalability, and debuggability. It incorporates chat functionality for users to interact regarding lost and found items.  The structure prioritizes authorization independence by denormalizing necessary authorization data, avoiding the need for `get()` calls in security rules. It employs structural segregation, ensuring that each collection houses documents with similar security requirements. This promotes simple, robust, and easily debuggable security rules.  Path-based ownership is used where appropriate to make security rules efficient.  The addition of the `chats` subcollection maintains a clear structure for managing conversations related to specific items. The `messages` subcollection within each chat facilitates real-time interaction between users. This design allows for easy querying of messages within a chat and simplifies the implementation of security rules, ensuring that only participants of a chat can access its messages. The inclusion of `itemId` in the `ChatMessage` allows the system to link each message to a specific `Item`, improving data context and user experience.
